Submitted. Summary of the repair:

- **Kept the locked status** (deviation) and the **preferred** level, with no hybrid.
- **Closed the two unmet preferred elements**: the CGL item carried no limits, so a single concise sentence was inserted after p0213 fixing "not less than one million dollars ($1,000,000) per occurrence and two million dollars ($2,000,000) in the aggregate". A same-sentence replacement failed the official word-expansion gate (1.91 > 1.50), so a separate minimal insertion was used, leaving item 1 byte-for-byte intact.
- **Retained** the E&O ($2,000,000) and cyber/privacy ($5,000,000) items as new 5 and 6, aligning the capitalisation to "Customer Data".
- **Added nothing extra** — no post-termination coverage or survival tail, no edits to workers' compensation or the certificates provision, both of which were mapped as already_met with verbatim quotes.
- Comment trimmed to explain only the operative change (fallback offer dropped, since the proposal now stands squarely at preferred).
